description: Four logic gates in a ring, each combining one input with its neighbour, and a four-bit staircase built from the four results

params.text: Sets the rate limit on the SLEW output, from about 18000 volts per second fully anticlockwise down to 1 volt per second fully clockwise

inputs.text: Read as high above 1V and low below it, and paired with the input on each side of it, the fourth wrapping round to the first, to make two of the logic outputs
With a cable here the four logic outputs only change on a rise above 1V at this jack; with nothing here they follow the inputs at every sample

outputs.text: 5V or 0V from the chosen logic operation applied to inputs I and II
5V or 0V from the chosen logic operation applied to inputs II and III
5V or 0V from the chosen logic operation applied to inputs III and IV
5V or 0V from the chosen logic operation applied to inputs IV and I
The STEP staircase passed through a rate limiter set by the SLEW knob
A staircase made by adding a weight for each logic output that is high, each weight double the one before, giving sixteen levels between 0V and about 8.2V

notes: the logic operation is chosen on the panel menu and the module comes up in XOR.
menu: OR — puts an output high while either of its two inputs is above 1V
AND — puts an output high only while both of its two inputs are above 1V
XOR — puts an output high while exactly one of its two inputs is above 1V
NOR — puts an output high while neither of its two inputs is above 1V
NAND — puts an output high unless both of its two inputs are above 1V
XNOR — puts an output high while its two inputs are both above 1V or both below it
